decision: The owner accepted the contributor's request to classify this dedicated service suffix under the existing mainland website policy in both products.

dns_observation.limits: A time- and location-dependent DNS snapshot; shared canonical names and IP ranges are not admitted.

first_match_audit.method: Check rule_covers against all canonical entries, then compare coverage_metrics and first_match in a proposed source model before editing.

boundary.selection: The service root and every subdomain; example subdomains describe routing scope rather than a verified inventory of live endpoints.

verification_limits: The rule is an approved service-routing preference, not a claim of mainland-only hosting. HTTP and DNS observations do not establish direct-path client reachability or performance. Before-change domain-only simulation reaches FINAL; actual connections can still match destination-IP or GEOIP rules.
